items.title: Marty Grosz interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995
items.q: Yeah, Carole King, Neil Sedaka, they worked there.

ctx.x: Yeah, Carole King, Neil Sedaka, they worked there. Probably the same room, it probably still smelled like cigar smoke.
Yeah. Only difference is now it’s pot.
